tools.name: Cube_SetSpeed
tools.description: Set the cube rotation speed in degrees per second

tools.name: Cube_RandomColor
tools.description: Change the color of the cube to a random bright color

tools.name: Cube_DecreaseOpacity
tools.description: Decrease the opacity of the cube (make it more transparent / see-through / ghostly)

amount.description: Optional amount to decrease opacity by (0.0 to 1.0, default 0.25)

tools.name: Cube_IncreaseOpacity
tools.description: Increase the opacity of the cube (make it more solid / opaque)

amount.description: Optional amount to increase opacity by (0.0 to 1.0, default 0.25)

tools.name: Cube_SetOpacity
tools.description: Set the cube opacity to a specific value between 0.0 (transparent) and 1.0 (opaque)

tools.name: Cube_SetScale
tools.description: Change the size of the cube (make it bigger, huge, giant, smaller, tiny, normal)

multiplier.description: Size scale multiplier relative to original (e.g. 0.5 for small, 2.0 for big/huge, 1.0 for normal size)

tools.name: Cube_Jump
tools.description: Make the cube jump or bounce up into the air and land smoothly back down

height.description: Optional jump height in meters (default is 1.2 meters)

tools.name: Cube_Float
tools.description: Make the cube levitate, hover, or float gently up and down in mid-air

enable.description: True to start floating/levitating, false to stop

tools.name: Cube_Pulse
tools.description: Make the cube beat, pulse, or breathe like a heartbeat

enable.description: True to start pulsing, false to stop pulsing

tools.name: Cube_Rainbow
tools.description: Make the cube cycle smoothly through all rainbow colors continuously (disco / party / rainbow mode)

enable.description: True to start rainbow cycle, false to stop

tools.name: Cube_Reset
tools.description: Reset the cube back to its original state (stop all animations, reset position, scale, color, and opacity)
